# Step 2.102: the look of sign-in, the account pages and SR Leagues' own pages

Design note. SR Leagues' own look, never a league's: `platformDesign` (`apps/web/src/features/shell/standalone-page.tsx`, T-325), the neutral design's colors (pale page, white panel, one blue) with a serif (`gelasio`) for titles, served as `/standalone.css` to every page that belongs to no league.
The form card (`packages/ui/src/styles/form-card-css.ts`, `ui-form-card` on `.ui-message`): centered, about 420 wide, a blue rule on top, a kicker ("SR Leagues"), a serif title (28 on a phone, 36 above), labels above full-width fields 44 high, one main button filled blue, quiet links beneath, space 16 to 48.
One colour lands: the blue (main button, top rule, kicker rule, the ways on). Shared pieces: `SubmitButton` (`kind` main or second), `OrLine`, `EmailField`/`PasswordField` (`ui-field`, `ui-field-row`), `.ui-apart` (a block set apart by a hairline), `.ui-rows` (rows with hairlines, no bullets).
Part 2 (builder 2): SR Leagues' own pages (front, find a league, start, help, contact, status, terms, privacy) on the same design value; the form card is for forms only.

## Review

Design reviewer (did not build it): 10 pictures, a Playwright walk at 320 and 390 on the build of e0118018 (stand-in), contrast measured. High: none.
Medium: `/signup/code` with nothing waiting (320, 390; `apps/web/src/app/(platform)/signup/code/page.tsx` 32-44): it says "Nothing is waiting… Start again." yet shows the Code box and a filled blue "Continue" that cannot work; the way that works, "Start again", is the quiet link (section 4, lines 19 and 27).
Low: `/signin` wrong password (320, 390): the refusal is a `role=alert` above both fields, no field marked `aria-invalid`, focus left on the page; the email is kept. Fair for a two-field refusal.
Low: `/signup/password`: a password under 8 is stopped by the browser's own bubble (`minLength`, `sign-in-parts.tsx` 246), in the browser's words and look, not the site's refusal under the field (line 7, T-187). Older than this step.
Low: `/account` (390, 1280): "Signed in as …" stands where every other card has the "SR Leagues" kicker (line 24).
Low: `display-css.ts` ships the form-card and page-card CSS in `/display.css` to every league and admin page; `.ui-field`, `.ui-field-row` and `.ui-message .ui-refusal[data-ask]` (`form-card-css.ts` 67-119) are not scoped to the card. No league page uses them today.
Low: `scripts/shots.mjs` 1842: `--measure` measures league pages only (`publicPage`), so it could never have measured this step's pages; measured here instead (below).
Low: the platform look has no dark version: with a dark preference the pages draw light (measured the same). Matches T-325.
Low (league frame, not this step): league not-found at 320 and 390, footer "Terms" 36 wide and "Privacy" 43 wide (44 high). The front page links to no terms or privacy (before and after).
Passed by measurement at 320 and 390: sign in, wrong password, already signed in, "use another account" (to `/signin?notice=signedOut`), sign up, code, choose password, account (7 leagues), password again and its refusal (`aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` on the field), forgot, sign out (to `/?notice=signedOut`), front, both not-found pages: no sideways scroll, nothing outside or cut off, every platform tap target at least 44, every field labelled, a focus ring on every stop, in order. Forced `dir=rtl` mirrors (Show moves left).
Contrast (`measureContrast` from `shots.mjs`, light and dark preference): front, sign in and its two notices, sign up, forgot, terms, account, password again: 0 short of AA, lowest 4.88 (refusal text), kicker 5.51.
The line: a league's not-found loads only `/display.css` in the league's frame; platform pages and `/no-such-league` load `/standalone.css`. No league named in added code, no literal interface text in added `.tsx`, nothing in `apps/live-stats` or `packages/sports` changed.
Not checked: the account problem page in a browser (the stand-in cannot make one; code read: card, kicker, title, one "Sign out"); a real right-to-left language (none exists); a screen reader heard; 1280 only in pictures.

## Fix round

Done: `/signup/code` with nothing waiting has no code box and no "Continue"; "Start again" is its one filled button (test:web row, find-their-way). After "Wrong email or password" both fields carry `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` to the refusal (`form-refusal`), and focus moves to the first wrong field, else the refusal (`focus-refusal.tsx`, on every sign-in screen with a problem); unit test and find-their-way.
The form card's field and ask rules are scoped to `.ui-form-card`; the account card has the "SR Leagues" kicker with "Signed in as…" under it (find-their-way's account check now reads both). The other four Lows are lines in `docs/build/polish.md`.
Checks: check, typecheck, test:web 263, vitest sign-in 10, the whole browser chain 57 of 57 (find-their-way 89, harmful-text 2058 after the line below, nothing-unfinished 2369, sign-in-says 81).
harmful-text now starts a made-up sign-up so `/signup/code` draws its box, types the attack into it and lists the box it saw (2058 checks); find-their-way keeps the "nothing waiting, no box" check.
Distrust: the focus move needs scripts; with them off the page reads as before.
Decisions: none new (the lead's, written in the brief).
